In [[Four-dimensional space|four-dimensional]] [[Euclidean geometry]], the '''omnitruncated tesseractic honeycomb''' is a uniform space-filling [[honeycomb (geometry)|honeycomb]]. It has [[omnitruncated tesseract]], [[truncated cuboctahedral prism]], and [[8-8 duoprism]] facets in an irregular [[5-cell]] [[vertex figure]].
